metadata.physical_status_scope: Broad under_construction for Phase B of the Modi'in facility only. Phase A, delivered in Q3 2025 and operating, is not selected as current construction. No fit-out stage, completion percentage or energization is inferred.
metadata.successor_review: Phase B remains under construction in the report signed on August 9. No Phase B delivery, completion or cancellation was found through August 20 in a bounded review; the Phase A operation is a different project on the same campus, not a successor.
